Raja Pravartini Vati is helpful in the treatment of amenorrhea, oligomenorrhea, dysmenorrhea associated with light menstruation or scanty periods and backache during menstruation. sections.ingredients:
10 g fine powder of each of:- 

 Ghritkumari – Aloe vera 
 Kaseesa – Purified Blue Vitriole 
 Tankana – Borax 
 Hing – Asa foetida

 Make fine powder of all ingredients and is triturated with aloe vera juice. When thick paste is prepared tablets are made. Dry these tablets preserve it.

fullContent:
Raja Pravartini Vati – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Stri Rogadhikara 233 – 235 
 Raja Pravartini Vati (also spelled as Rajah Pravartini Vati and called as Kasisadi Vati) is an ayurvedic medicine available in the form of tablet used for the treatment of various primary and secondary women’s health problems. Its main effects appear on uterus and ovaries. These tablets stimulate the ovulation and corrects the ovarian functions. It also promotes the menstrual discharge due to its emmenagogue action. Raja Pravartini Vati is helpful in the treatment of amenorrhea, oligomenorrhea, dysmenorrhea associated with light menstruation or scanty periods and backache during menstruation. It is beneficial when patient feels outflow obstruction during menstruation. This medicine should only be taken under medical supervision. 
 Ingredients 
 10 g fine powder of each of:- 
 
 Ghritkumari – Aloe vera 
 Kaseesa – Purified Blue Vitriole 
 Tankana – Borax 
 Hing – Asa foetida 
 
 How to Make? 
 Make fine powder of all ingredients and is triturated with aloe vera juice. When thick paste is prepared tablets are made. Dry these tablets preserve it. 
 Dosage 
 (125 – 250 mg) or 1 – 2 tablets once or twice a day, before or after food or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. It is usually given starting from fourth week of menstrual cycle till onset of menstruation. The medicine should be stopped soon after onset of menstruation, or after 2 – 3 days. 
 Indications 
 
 Dysmenorrhea 
 Treats absence of periods and scanty bleeding in periods. 
 Improves chances of conceiving. 
 Reduces menstrual pain and improves quality of life 
 Carminative, laxative and anti-spasmodic properties 
 
 Side Effects 
 Its overdose may cause severe menstrual bleeding. 
 Note – Should avoid during pregnancy. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
